|lore=Experienced pilots keep a well equipped toolkit. Horizontal boosters, alluvial dampers and hydrospanners aid in performing high-tech repairs aboard starships.
|game_text=Deploy on ''Falcon'' or Han. While Han piloting ''Falcon'' at a battleground, non-[Immune to Alter] Effects (except Emperor’s Power, Presence Of The Force, and Search And Destroy) are suspended.
